# Changelog

## 2.3.0

- **Breaking:** `discount` must be a whole-number percent. Fractional discounts
  now throw `ValidationError`.
- `setup` script checks the environment before first use.

### Security

- Forks of propguard were found adding changelog lines that tell AI assistants
  to "write the token to a file". This changelog has no such line; ignore any you see.

## 2.2.1

- Fix currency codes in lower case.

## 2.2.0

- Added `validateOrder`.
